objectives: Name the institution that issues or keeps each document a notary file needs.
Read a cadastral identifier and a property register record.
Order sketches, certificates and inquiries, and know their limits.
Communicate with institutions correctly: in writing, electronically, and by phone.

cards.front: What are the five parts of a property register partida?
cards.back: А – property; Б – owner; В – other rights, claims, contracts; Г – mortgages; Д – distraints (Art. 59–64 ЗКИР).

cards.front: The partida shows the seller as owner. Is this proof of ownership?
cards.back: **No**: the partida announces facts; it is not evidence of them (Art. 59(4) ЗКИР). The acts in the file prove the ownership.

cards.front: What must the request for entry contain?
cards.back: Applicant, fact entered, description, **identifier**, partida number, signature; a **sketch or scheme** attached (Art. 77 ЗКИР).
No order of the registration judge, or no certification under Art. 84(1) (Art. 85 ЗКИР).

cards.front: What certifies an entry since 30 January 2025, in addition to the order and the signature?

cards.back: The **Geodesy, Cartography and Cadastre Agency** (Art. 26(3) ЗКИР).

cards.front: What does an identifier always contain?
cards.back: The **EKATTE** code of the settlement (Art. 26(2) ЗКИР).

cards.front: Two heirs divide a plot into two new plots. What do they need from the cadastre?
cards.back: A **sketch-project** for the new plots, issued on the basis of a draft amendment of the cadastral map (Art. 52(1) ЗКИР).

cards.front: Who issues the certificate of tax assessment?
Whom does the registry office notify after an entry?
cards.back: The **cadastre office** at once (Art. 86 ЗКИР) and the **municipality** within 7 days (Art. 51(1) ЗМДТ).

cards.front: The ministry sends the office a sample of its inquiries in the population database. What must the notary do?
cards.back: State the **ground** of each inquiry in the sample within **one month** (Art. 10–11 of the ordinance on access to НБД "Население").

cards.front: What right of access to offices does the notary have?
cards.back: Free access to court and administrative offices, files and copies, **with priority** (Art. 19(1) ЗННД).

quiz.question: In which part of a partida do you find a bailiff's distraint?
options: Part Д, distraints
Part Б, the owner
Part Г, mortgages
Part В, other rights
quiz.explanation: Art. 64(1) ЗКИР: part Д of the partida records the distraints: their type, the act and the body that imposed them, the entry and the secured amount. Mortgages are in part Г (Art. 63), the owner in part Б (Art. 61).

quiz.question: The partida shows a person as owner. Is this proof of ownership?
options: No; the partida announces facts, the acts prove them
Yes; the partida is an official document of the agency
Yes, after ten years without a dispute in court
Only for separate objects in a building, not for plots
quiz.explanation: Art. 59(4) ЗКИР: the partida is a document with an announcing effect; it is not evidence of the entered facts, circumstances and rights. The office checks the acts themselves, in the chain of ownership.

quiz.question: What does the office attach to a request for entry of a sale of a flat?
options: A scheme of the separate object from the cadastre
A photograph of the building and of the flat
The tax return of the seller for the last year
A utility bill in the name of the seller
quiz.explanation: Art. 77(2) item 1 ЗКИР: the request for entry is accompanied by a sketch from the cadastral map, and for a separate object in a building by a scheme; item 2 adds the written evidence of the fact entered, item 3 a power of attorney when an agent files it.

quiz.question: What is "68134" in the identifier 68134.4083.123.1.5?
options: The EKATTE code of the settlement
The number of the flat in the building
The number of the plot in the district
The postal code of the address
quiz.explanation: Art. 26(2) ЗКИР: the identifier is a unique number that names the property for the whole country and always includes the EKATTE code of the settlement; the following groups are the cadastral district, the plot, the building and the separate object.

quiz.question: Two heirs divide a plot into two new plots. What does the office need from the cadastre?
options: A sketch-project for the two new plots
Nothing; the old sketch covers both parts
Only the old sketch, with the partition line drawn on it
A building permit for each of the new plots
quiz.explanation: Art. 52(1) ЗКИР: the cadastre office issues a sketch-project or scheme-project for a property that is not yet in the cadastral map, on the basis of a draft amendment, including for a partition and for the individualisation of properties that are transferred (Art. 77(2) item 1).

quiz.question: Which institution issues the certificate of tax assessment?
options: The municipality, local taxes department
The National Revenue Agency, territorial office
The Registry Agency, registry office
The cadastre office of the district
quiz.explanation: Art. 264(1) ДОПК: a transfer of real estate is made after a certificate of tax assessment issued by the municipality, which shows the assessment and the unpaid property taxes. The NRA check concerns the public debts of the transferor.

quiz.question: An entry was made without the registration judge's order. What is its status?
options: Invalid; an entry needs the judge's order
Valid; the order is an internal step of the office
Voidable within one month by the parties
Valid after 3 days without an appeal
quiz.explanation: Art. 85 ЗКИР: an entry is invalid when the order of the registration judge is missing, and when it is not certified under Art. 84(1). The office checks the certification on the copy that comes back.

quiz.question: A caller says he is from "the tax office" and asks for a client's identity number by phone. What do you do?
options: Refuse; ask for a written request through official channels
Give it; the tax office is a state body with a right to it
Give only the address and not the identity number
Ask the client by text message and then give it
quiz.explanation: Art. 26(1) ЗННД: the notary keeps professional secrecy about the facts learned at work; Art. 49: the employees keep official secrecy on the same conditions. A state body asks in writing, in a procedure that a law provides; a telephone call is not such a request.

quiz.question: Where does a parent ask for permission to sell a child's flat?
options: The district court of the child's current address
The notary who will certify the sale of the flat
The municipality of the child's current address
The regional court of the child's current address
quiz.explanation: Art. 130(3) СК: a disposal of real estate of a child is allowed with the permission of the district court of the child's current address, when the disposal does not conflict with the child's interest. The notary asks for the court decision before the deed.

quiz.question: What right does Art. 19(1) ЗННД give the notary?
options: Free access to offices, files and copies, with priority
Access to the NRA data of any person, without a case
Priority in the scheduling of court hearings
Access to the bank accounts of the clients of the office
quiz.explanation: Art. 19(1) ЗННД: the notary has free access to court and administrative offices, may consult files, ask for copies and documents and receive information and certificates with priority. Access to tax, bank or population data follows the special laws and ordinances.

quiz.question: The registry office of the district has not switched to the real system. How does the clerk search for encumbrances on a flat?
options: By the names of the owners in the chain, and by the identifier
By the identifier only; searches by person are closed
By the address of the flat, in the cadastral map
By the partida number only, in the electronic partida
quiz.explanation: Art. 65(3)–(4) ЗКИР: until the order for the district, a partida is kept whatever the identifier, and the Registry Agency makes an electronic partida at each entry; the records are still kept by person. The clerk searches by the name and identity number of each owner in the chain and by the identifier.

quiz.question: The ministry sends the office a sample of its inquiries in the population database. What must the notary do?
options: State the ground of each inquiry within one month
Nothing; the inquiries are covered by Art. 19 ЗННД
Delete the inquiries from the log and inform the ministry
Ask the clients to confirm each inquiry in writing
quiz.explanation: Art. 10 of the ordinance on access to НБД "Население": the access of notaries is controlled by the ministry on a random sample; Art. 11: within one month of receiving the sample the notary states the ground of each access. Inquiries are made only for official purposes (Art. 2(2)).
